meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 自动跑完插件发布流程:把版本号同步进八个清单文件、构建并校验、打 git tag、建 GitHub release、重新生成 CHANGELOG;npm publish 留给你本人手动执行。
howto.when: 当你要给 Claude Code 插件升版本号或发新版时接管;它按改动性质判定 PATCH、MINOR 或 MAJOR,并一路做到 npm 发布前一步。

say.text: 把版本号升到 1.2.0,走完整个发布流程
say.note: 结束后只等你手动跑 npm publish

say.text: 这是破坏性改动,按 MAJOR 升版并发 release
say.note: 会同步八个清单并重新生成 CHANGELOG

say.text: 核对所有清单里的版本号,看还有没有旧版本残留
say.note: 用 git grep 检查八个文件

howto.what_en: Automates the plugin release flow: syncs the version across eight manifest files, verifies the build, creates the git tag and GitHub release, and regenerates the changelog. npm publish is left as the final human step.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to bump a Claude Code plugin's version or cut a release. It classifies the change as PATCH, MINOR or MAJOR and runs the workflow up to, but not including, npm publish.

say_en.text: Bump the version to 1.2.0 and run the whole release flow
say_en.note: Afterwards it waits for you to run npm publish

say_en.text: This is a breaking change, do a MAJOR bump and release
say_en.note: Syncs all eight manifests and regenerates the changelog

say_en.text: Check the version in every manifest for old-version leftovers
say_en.note: Uses git grep on the eight files
